title: trip_lifecycle_event
description: Buoc 2 cua ke hoach mock telemetry. Hop dong NHAP tong hop tu quan sat truc tiep may trang thai tren app Xanh SM Driver - CHI TIET HON HAN trips.schema.json cua GSM_SIMULATOR (chi co enum status ['completed','cancelled','assigned']). Day chinh la du lieu con thieu ma docs/appendix-pending-data.md va tier_a/fake_no_show.py, off_app_cash_pressure.py da neu ('khong co trang thai arrived') - quan sat thuc te xac nhan trang thai nay TON TAI THAT trong san pham, chi la GSM_SIMULATOR chua mock no. Day la thay doi phan loai quan trong: tu 'chua co bang chung' sang 'da co bang chung UI/quy trinh that, chi thieu trong bo mock'.

trip_id.description: null cho su kien CAP PHIEN/tai khoan, khong gan voi mot cuoc cu the - went_online, went_offline, app_foreground, app_background, driver_break_started, driver_break_ended, manual_location_toggle (hang muc 4 'Chien luoc lam giau du lieu'). Bat buoc khac null cho moi event_type con lai (vong doi mot cuoc cu the).

customer_id.description: Co the null tam thoi cho toi khi tong dai ghep - cuoc XanhNow (via_xanhnow=true) van co customer_id sau khi khop OTP, chi la khong qua dieu phoi trung tam.

offer_countdown_seconds.description: Chi dinh (khac null) khi event_type='offer_received' - quan sat thuc te: dem nguoc 15 giay de tai xe bam Xac nhan/Bo qua. LUU Y THIET KE: KHONG dung 'const:15' o day - const ap dung cho CA gia tri null (JSON Schema doi khop instance null voi const, khong mien tru), se lam moi event KHAC offer_received (dung null hop le) bi tu choi sai. Da phat hien loi nay khi chay thu Buoc 3 (17/24 event bi tu choi oan) - sua lai thanh khong rang buoc const, chi ghi chu gia tri quan sat duoc.

arrival_geofence_check_passed.description: Chi dinh khi event_type='arrived_at_pickup'. He thong that KIEM TRA GPS tai xe co nam trong ban kinh cho phep quanh diem hen truoc khi cho bam 'Da den diem don' - day CHINH LA du lieu can cho fake_no_show.py va off_app_cash_pressure.py. Ban kinh cu the (met) CHUA quan sat duoc tu UI - can do thuc nghiem hoac hoi doi GSM.

arrival_geofence_radius_m.description: CHUA XAC DINH - placeholder. Uu tien lam ro o buoc 1 tiep theo (do thuc nghiem: dung xa diem hen bao nhieu m thi nut 'Da den' bi khoa).

via_xanhnow.description: true neu cuoc duoc khop qua tinh nang XanhNow (khach vay xe doc duong, nhap ma OTP 4 so vao app tai xe) THAY VI qua dieu phoi trung tam. Quan sat: day la KE HO that su - khong co kiem chung cheo tu tong dai, tai xe co the bat tay voi 'khach quen' bam vay xe gia. Ung vien mau hinh MOI (chua co trong F1-F6 hay 15 mau hinh cu) - xem docs/telemetry-research.md.

xanhnow_otp_code_masked.description: Mask OTP that (vd 'XXXX') khi luu log - day la du lieu nhay cam ngan han, khong can luu nguyen ban.

location_enabled.description: Chi dinh khi event_type='manual_location_toggle' - true neu tai xe VUA BAT lai dinh vi, false neu VUA TAT. Day la tin hieu cot loi cho 'giu trang thai online ao': tat dinh vi thu cong nhung khong goi went_offline nghia la tai xe van hien 'dang online' voi khach/he thong dieu phoi trong khi thuc te khong the nhan cuoc.
